It should read as a member of the exact same procession, not a fantasy warrior, knight, demon or elaborate armored boss. A clean asset sheet on plain warm light grey: one dominant complete front three-quarter figure and one smaller complete back figure, consistent height/proportions/costume, no weapons, hands naturally visible at sides. Fine anime illustration with painted cloth volume and subdued warm edge lighting, detailed but clean silhouette, all head/robe/boots within frame. No people besides these two views of the same acolyte. No text, no labels, no swatches, no watermark, no prompt area, no corpses or gore.
